input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors.what: First docstring draft carried a placeholder count (12 of 14) before measuring; replaced with the measured 10 of 12 before commit.
First merge-tree probe of five stalled branches printed nothing because the shallow clone had no merge base (error swallowed by my pipe); looked clean, was not. Deepened main by 1500 and re-ran.

doc_friction.issue: Its 'checks: green' column read as 'ready to merge'; 10 of 12 green rows conflicted with today's main. Fixed here: merge column from GitHub's mergeable flag.

Critique mode points at the doc-friction table, which ~20 process runs today had already worked through; the stalled-PR queue (orphan_prs.py, 35 rows) is a better default lens and nothing a run reads mentions orphan_prs.py (grep: only its own file and test).
The backlog is under /prompts/ (CODEOWNERS), so a process run filing a new item makes its whole PR owner-gated; the auto-merge question went to docs/reports instead.

deviations.why: Critique mode suggests filing problems as backlog items; the backlog path is owner-gated and would hold this PR's product work (#15450).

notes: Backlog had only owner/blocked rows; main_health 62/62 green. Lens: stalled PRs. Merged #15460 (31 checks green, clean; local merge with main: run_venture_tests einvoice-preflight/uk-sole-trader/isolation-forest ok, check_post_frontmatter 0, promptctl validate ok). Adopted #15450 into this PR (2 conflicts resolved, answer-lead 57/57, venture tests ok). Closed #15196 as duplicate of #15198. orphan_prs tests 8/8; full run 52 s, 34 rows. No backlog ids touched.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: triage of 12 stalled PRs, two merges with conflict resolution, tool change with tests, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
